title: AI labs’ safety warnings also shape who controls the rules
friendlyTitle: AI companies want safety rules—and a say in writing them
summary: AP examines how Anthropic and OpenAI are calling for independent testing and tighter controls on advanced models while also seeking influence over the standards that could govern their industry. The report separates the companies’ stated safety concerns from their political and commercial incentives.
friendlySummary: Anthropic and OpenAI say powerful AI needs stronger safety checks. AP explains that these companies may also benefit if they help decide what the rules look like.
whyItMatters: Businesses choosing AI vendors should treat safety claims as evidence to examine, not a substitute for independent assurance. Procurement decisions increasingly need clear testing, incident disclosure and accountability requirements.
friendlyWhyItMatters: When choosing an AI service, do not rely only on the company’s promises. Ask for independent tests, clear incident reports and someone who is responsible when things go wrong.
